body.purpose: UI content, menu items, preview chrome.

mono.purpose: Code listings, keyboard hints, file names.

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: Ghost action in the top toolbar; hover raises a tonal fill.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { font: 500 0.875rem/1.3 -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; color: #24292f; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-toolbar:hover { background: #f6f8fa; color: #1f2328; } .ds-toolbar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toolbar:active { background: #d0d7de; }

components.name: Toolbar Checkbox
components.description: Accent-driven boolean control in the toolbar.
components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.3 -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; color: #57606a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check input { accent-color: #0f766e; } .ds-check:hover { color: #24292f; } .ds-check input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f766e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check:has(input:checked) { color: #24292f; }

narrative.overview: Markdown-Studio is a writing surface where the tool disappears into the task. It speaks the language of a calm, professional workbench: flat neutral ground, one restrained accent reserved for action and state, hairline separations instead of card stacks, and a typography system tuned to screen work rather than billboards. The interface never competes with the document being written; it recedes so the artifact leads.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default; tonal layering, not shadow cards.
One restrained accent; used for action, focus, selection and state only.
System-first type stack — familiar sans for UI, mono for code.
Compact spacing rhythm (4/8/12/16) for a dense-but-calm tool.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The petrol accent appears on ≤10% of any visible surface. Its rarity is what tells the user where to act; overusing it turns the tool into decoration.

rules.name: The Gray-On-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is tinted from the neutral foreground (Ink Soft / Moon Muted), never a flat gray dropped on a colored surface.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: UI type uses fixed rem steps, not fluid clamps. The tool is viewed at constant DPI; fluid headings inside a sidebar look wrong, not responsive.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The tint change is the hover/active feedback; shadows never decorate controls.

dos: Do use the petrol accent for one thing at a time — focus, selection, or primary action — never in bulk.
Do separate panels with the hairline divider, not borders around each pane.
Do keep UI type on a fixed rem scale (0.8125–1.5rem); no clamps in chrome.
Do give every interactive element default / hover / focus-visible / active states.
Do tint secondary text from the neutral foreground (Ink Soft / Moon Muted).
donts: Don't use pure black or pure gray text (#000/#808080); use Ink/Moon neutrals.
Don't put cards inside the workspace; the studio is flat-tonal, not card-stacked.
Don't use Arial, Helvetica, or Inter first in a font stack (overused, template-tell).
Don't add box-shadows to controls or panels.
Don't animate with bounce/elastic easing; state transitions are 150–250ms on transform/color/background.
Don't render gray-on-gray or gray-on-tint secondary labels.
